observations: Photo shows an exposed engine bay/engine assembly on the ground (no full vehicle shown).
Multiple hoses, wiring, intake/exhaust components visible; engine appears partially disassembled or at least not in a complete car setup.
No readable VIN/engine code, no dashboard/odometer, and no clear branding/model badge visible in the photo.
A watermark text is visible, but it does not confirm the engine model.

claims.evidence: Photo does not show a readable Lexus/LX460 badge, engine code, or any identifying label.
No shipping/import documents, VIN plate, or labels visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photo cannot confirm running condition, knocking sound, mileage, or whether the engine has been opened.

risks.risk: Engine identity mismatch (not actually LX460 / wrong engine).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the engine identification plate/engine code (e.g., on engine block) plus the full engine from multiple angles showing any model markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown used engine (worst-case: not guaranteed for the claimed model).

risks.risk: Not actually tested/running; internal damage possible (knock, bearing wear, head issues).
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine running (cold start if possible) with a short audio segment, plus a mechanic test report.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: treat as not working / needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Mileage claim may be false; could be high-mileage or rebuilt.
risks.proof: Provide engine code + any service/odometer evidence from the donor vehicle, or a compression/leak-down test result.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown mileage (worst-case: high wear).

risks.risk: “Never opened” claim may be false (previous repairs, resealed parts, swapped components).
risks.proof: Photos of fasteners/seals around the cylinder head cover, oil pan, and timing components showing original condition; plus a mechanic inspection note.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly opened/overhauled (worst-case: unknown condition).

risks.risk: Missing parts / incomplete engine assembly (some components may be absent).
risks.proof: Photo checklist: show the full engine laid out with all accessories, sensors, alternator, starter, intake/throttle body, and any included parts clearly counted.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/identification plate on the engine block (readable).
Video of the engine running with audio (showing no knock) and ideally a cold start.
Compression test and/or leak-down test results (with readings).
Photos showing completeness: all accessories/sensors and what exactly is included (counted).
Any import/shipping documents or donor vehicle details that support “Belgium” and mileage.
response.reason: From the single photo, the engine’s exact identity (LX460) and the seller’s key claims (tested/working, no knock, low mileage, never opened, Belgium origin) cannot be verified remotely. Without engine code and running/compression proof, pricing would be guesswork.
